name: Spotify Playlist TV Browser
description: Makes playlist tracks larger with better spacing for D-pad navigation on TV

params.css: [data-testid='tracklist-row'] { min-height: 64px !important; padding: 8px 16px !important; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important; } [data-testid='tracklist-row']:hover, [data-testid='tracklist-row']:focus-within { background: rgba(29,185,84,0.15) !important; outline: 2px solid #1db954 !important; border-radius: 8px !important; } [data-testid='tracklist-row'] span, [data-testid='tracklist-row'] a { font-size: 18px !important; } [data-testid='tracklist-row'] img { width: 52px !important; height: 52px !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } [data-testid='playlist-page'] h1 { font-size: 36px !important; }
